[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use case 1: Annotation includes steps for Tagger user to log in, select a task, classify the document, select and place labels, adjust labels, edit labels, change label color, save progress, and repeat until finished.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use case 2: Review includes steps for Checker user to log in, select a task, review labels, approve or reject labels, modify labels, add comments, and submit the review task.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use case 4: Annotation history includes steps for Tagger or Checker user to log in, select a task, click on a label, view annotation history, and review it.
